dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly irregular and jagged spline along the trailing edge with multiple non-linear inflection points indicating significant tissue loss.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius and no acute angular termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear slope relative to the horizontal cropped baseline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive deep notches and indentations along the entire trailing edge; multiple horizontal linear rake marks (parallel scarring) on the lateral surface; white punctate markings near the posterior base.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of deep V-shaped notches and distinct parallel lateral scarring patterns.
